description: Accepted npm audit advisories for this repository. Checked by scripts/check-audit-exceptions.mjs in CI: any advisory not listed here, or any entry past its review date, fails the build.

exceptions.reason: Dev-only tool. markdownlint-cli2 only reads this repository's own Markdown with a fixed glob from .markdownlint-cli2.jsonc; it is never shipped and never run against untrusted input. The only offered fix is a downgrade of markdownlint-cli2.
Dev-only tool. This repository has no TOML configuration; the parser never receives untrusted input. Not shipped.
Dev-only tool. Math rendering is not used; lint output is never rendered in a browser. Not shipped.
